payload.title: install offers practices, not the whole corpus
payload.body: Default install becomes an interactive choice of practices, each a set of agents, skills and hooks installed together; --all keeps today's whole-corpus install. Rectified: a practice must be CLOSED under both skill composition and agent dispatch, or it ships a broken agent (mav alone dispatches planner, implementer and assayer, so 'mav + design, plan, deliver' is not closed). Which practices exist is meaning, so canon declares them and the CLI only renders them. 'LLM archeology' is rejected by VISION (archaeology smuggles decay); the discipline's sign is latent lexicography. event-tap is plumbing, installed as a dependency, never offered. Non-TTY runs must never hang on a prompt: require --all or a named practice. The name of the grouping concept itself is owed to signify, not coined here. carry-on is its own practice, independent of delivery (operator ruling): resuming work on the re-dispatch word is useful without the design, plan and deliver family.
